title: Analyst Forecast Revisions and Market Price Formation
one_line: Prices under-react to analyst forecast revisions that carry new information (vs those that just move toward consensus); adjustment is faster for celebrity analysts and widely covered firms, and much of the delayed move happens at later earnings announcements.

findings.statement: Market doesn't separate high-innovation from low-innovation revisions.
Faster adjustment for All-Star analysts and high-coverage firms.
Delayed adjustment clusters around later announcements.

reported_results.headline: Prices under-react to analyst forecast revisions that carry new information (vs those that just move toward consensus); adjustment is faster for celebrity analysts and widely covered firms, and much of the delayed move happens at later earnings announcements.

data_fit: Single-stock study — not testable on our ES/NQ data.
caveats: Read by Claude in a chat session (manual run 4), not by the weekly pipeline.
